evidence.quote: So I would like to spend my time with you today focusing on how the Federal Reserve can achieve this objective in one specific area, that of our nation's payment system.
The FedNow SM Service, announced last August, will create a new payment infrastructure for institutions of all sizes to offer innovative faster payment services.
Another important area of focus for me is community banks' relationships with their vendors and third-party service providers.
